person.persName: أحمد بن يوسف البانياسي ثم الدمشقي

birth.note: Calculated from death date (803 AH) and age at death (70 years). Implied to be born in Banyas from his nisbah.

death.note: Died in Shaʿbān 803 AH at the age of 70.

relation.note: Some referred to his grandfather as Muḥammad (وسمى بعضهم جده محمدا) — a variant reported with low certainty.

event.note: Implied as his place of birth and early residence due to nisbah.
Implied as a later residence due to nisbah (then al-Dimashqī).

person.note: アフマド・ブン・ユースフ・アル=バーニヤースィー、後にアッ=ディマシュキー、クルアーン朗誦者。諸伝承（ローマ）で朗誦し、770年（代）よりアル=ファフルの学友の一部やその他の人々からハディースを聴聞した。803年シャアバーン月に70歳で死去した。我らがシャイフ（イブン・ハジャル）が自著『インバーゥ・アル=グムル』で彼に言及している。ある者たちは彼の祖父をムハンマドと呼んだ。

Aḥmad b. Yūsuf al-Bānyāsī, then al-Dimashqī, the Qurʾān reciter. He recited in the [canonical] transmissions and heard ḥadīth from the year 70 (the 770s) onward from some of the companions of al-Fakhr and others. He died in Shaʿbān 803 AH at the age of 70. Our shaykh (Ibn Ḥajar) mentioned him in his 『Inbāʾ al-Ghumr』. Some referred to his grandfather as Muḥammad.
